adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Row of 1-5 women facing singers; 15-foot path.

music_profile.musical_form: Sequence of songs performed throughout the night.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopation is frequent; rattle rhythm is approximately in eighth notes.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the sound of gourd rattles accompanying vocalists. Songs vary from near-monotones to those using ascending and descending minor thirds.
music_profile.vocal_style: Sung in the 'old language'; begins softly and increases in volume.

basic_steps: Stand in a row facing the singers.
Move backward and forward over a distance of approximately 15 feet.
teaching.formation: Row of 1-5 dancers facing the singers.
teaching.rhythm: Rattle-rhythm similar to eighth notes; some songs feature syncopation.
